title: Tharif & Zahraa
description: A pre-shoot in a park under a moody overcast sky, with the bride in red and gold and the groom in a black tuxedo, moving from tree-lined paths to a wooden deck over a pond with an umbrella for the drizzle. The reception follows in a chandelier-lit banquet hall with a pastel floral stage, a staircase entrance and the cake cutting.
